D.t: Kathy Hochul leads by 16.3 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 1,135,315 votes; a one point swing is about 34,804 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +9.6 and D +22.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +12.1. Your best recent poll is Beacon Research (D)/Shaw & Co. Research (R) at D +20.3; your worst is Pollfinity Research at D +4.0. 12 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: New York, a projected net 403,688 votes; Kings, a projected net 379,924 votes; Queens, a projected net 215,499 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Suffolk, R +7.9, 9.0% of the vote; Nassau, R +2.8, 8.4% of the vote; Orange, R +6.0, 2.1% of the vote; Dutchess, D +2.8, 1.8% of the vote.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Kathy Hochul runs furthest behind in Saratoga, Monroe, Dutchess. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 71% of voters, 51 to 48, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.57 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 62% of voters, 57 to 42, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.11 points; Voters who find daily costs hard to afford, 60% of voters, 59 to 40, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.02 points.
The forecast's worst groups for Kathy Hochul: Immigration voters 20 to 79, Small counties 35 to 63, Midsize counties 46 to 53. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$18.5M cash against $178K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
Money: Raised $6.3M against $2.6M for Kathy Hochul.
